name: M&M Cookies
desc: Thick chocolate chip cookies loaded with M&Ms, better after a day in the fridge

ingredients.raw: 1 cup unsalted butter, just barely softened
1 cup M&M’s, plus more for tops if desired
ingredients.prep: plus more for tops if desired

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with silicone baking mats or parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar for 1 minute.
Add the eggs and vanilla and mix until combined.
Add the flour, baking soda, and salt. Mix just until combined.
Fold in the chocolate chips and M&M’s.
Refrigerate the dough for 15-60 minutes (or up to 24 hours).
Using a large cookie scoop (about 3 tablespoons), scoop the dough onto the baking sheets about 2 inches apart. Add extra M&M’s on top if desired.
Bake for 7-10 minutes, or until the edges are barely golden brown.
Let cookies set on the pan for 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack.
